package.name: wojtek_targeting_msgs
package.description:
The interfaces of the wojtek_targeting experiment: the LaserTarget a detector publishes, the TargetingStatus the gimbal controller reports, and the manual-angle service used for bench calibration.
Separate from wojtek_targeting so that package can stay ament_python: a package cannot both generate interfaces and be a plain Python package without the two fighting over the same install directory.
